build_impala_replay_table: build a Reverb replay table with uniform sampling and FIFO removal for IMPALA training
build_impala_dataset_iterator: build a multi-device dataset iterator from a Reverb client for IMPALA learner updates
build_impala_adder: build a SequenceAdder to insert environment transitions into the Reverb replay buffer
build_impala_learner: build an IMPALA learner with an Adam optimizer and gradient clipping for training
build_impala_actor: build a GenericActor with a variable client that periodically syncs policy parameters
